page.notes: Printed in the right-hand column of the scan. Several page numbers at the ends of lines are faint and may be misread, notably "viles qui 904", "Vespasianus 668 a" and "vindictae cupiditas vnde 632 a". The verb "vtere" and the forms "quo\ modis" are copied as they appear, with the backslash-like mark standing for a printing flaw. No page number is printed on this page.
